# Alentro Global Services

> End-to-end IT services and data annotation company in Mumbai, India.
> Founded 2024. Pan-India operations. 24/7 support.

Alentro Global Services delivers comprehensive IT infrastructure, cloud services, cybersecurity, data annotation, and staff augmentation to businesses across Mumbai and Pan-India. 24/7 support via phone (+91-7045400592), email (alentroglobalservices@gmail.com), and WhatsApp.

## Core Services

- [IT Infrastructure Setup](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/it-infrastructure-setup): Complete server, storage, networking, and workstation design, procurement, and deployment.

- [Data Annotation Services](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/data-annotation): Image, text, audio, video, 3D point cloud, and document annotation for AI/ML models. 100% quality assured. 500+ annotators. 10M+ data points processed.

- [Cloud Services — AWS, Azure, GCP](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/cloud-services): Cloud migration, architecture design, managed operations, and FinOps cost optimisation.

- [Cybersecurity Solutions](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/cybersecurity-solutions): NGFW deployment (Fortinet, Sophos, Cisco), vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, EDR, and compliance.

- [Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/annual-maintenance-contracts): Comprehensive hardware, software, and network maintenance with quarterly health checks and dedicated account management.

- [In-House IT Support](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/in-house-it-support): Dedicated on-site IT professionals embedded within your organisation for same-floor issue resolution.

- [Helpdesk Services](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/helpdesk-services): 24/7 multi-tier L1/L2/L3 support with defined SLA response windows and real-time ticket tracking.

- [Network & Server Management](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/network-server-management): Proactive 24/7 LAN/WAN monitoring, configuration management, firmware updates, and capacity planning.

- [Staff Augmentation](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/staff-augmentation): Pre-screened certified IT professionals on flexible short-term or long-term contracts. Rapid deployment within 5-10 days.

- [IT Consulting](https://alentroglobalservices.com/services/it-consulting): IT strategy, roadmap planning, vendor selection, digital transformation advisory, and virtual CIO services.
